component.name: OpenVolley eScoresheet
component.summary: Offline volleyball scoresheet with a LAN server for the tablets

description.p: OpenVolley is an electronic scoresheet for indoor volleyball, made for the scorer's table. It follows the FIVB rules and the Swiss Volley regulations and replaces the paper scoresheet.

The desktop app runs fully offline and doubles as a server on the local network: the referee, bench and livescore tablets connect to it over the same Wi-Fi, with no internet and no accounts. It can start a Wi-Fi hotspot or a Bluetooth network for the tablets through NetworkManager.

ul.li: Match setup: teams, rosters, liberos, bench officials, referees
Coin toss, line-ups, rotations and the service order
Rally-by-rally scoring with undo and decision changes
Timeouts, substitutions, libero replacements, sanctions
Signatures and the scoresheet PDF of the finished match
Referee, bench and livescore views on other tablets
Optional cloud sync when the venue has internet

description.p: Languages: English, German, Swiss German, French, Italian.

screenshot.caption: The start screen: a new match or a restored one

ul.li: Coaches and captains can sign during the warm-up: the coin toss no longer waits for their signatures.

Until they have signed, the scoring screen flashes "Missing signature" for the team. Tap it to check the roster and sign, on the screen or on a phone. The match starts once the coach and the captain of both teams have signed.
Swiss German texts reviewed.
Backup files on the device are encrypted: the game PIN or the referee PIN opens them.
The match-end file can be restored, and a restored match keeps the PIN it was opened with.
The last backup is saved before the app closes, also when the computer shuts down or Android sends the app away.
No backup files of a copy another device continued.
A team's waiting roster no longer opens Match Setup by itself at start.
"Auto-download data at set end" is remembered.
Corrections: every entry can be corrected (line-ups after rallies, coin toss, liberos, sanctions, points); rotations, serve and score are recalculated.
A shirt number changed during the match changes for the whole match.
The event log shows the newest entries first.
Support requests can include a diagnostics report, shown before sending.
Correcting the deciding set's first serve reaches the server again.
Reloading the scoring screen no longer freezes the app on Linux, macOS and iPad.
A Point tap right after Start rally counts.
Home follows your sign-in; Official game lists your club's home games of the day.
Club managers run their own club's invite codes and members.
Help on every screen (the "?") with short videos; Support & feedback becomes a ticket.
Test matches never reach the cloud.
The bench circles the captain; the 1R name sits over the net.
The app opens on Home; the match in progress is one tap away (Continue). A reload goes back into it; 15 minutes in the background goes to Home.
Every start checks the device's matches with the server: a match finished or continued elsewhere is shown as such, read-only, and can be removed from this device safely.
Duplicate copies are flagged with a Clean up action, never deleted on their own.
A match continued on a device whose clock is far behind keeps the referee, bench and livescore following, however large the difference.
Time-out and set break countdowns are right on a referee tablet that joins or reloads during one, and an ended time-out stays closed.
Livescore: the list keeps updating after a game it showed disappeared during a connection drop.
Scoresheet: the score in a service box sits below the round number's tick, and the tick is shorter.
Scoresheet: the match type, gender and level are X'd on a match finished on another device; youth games get their age box.
Manual adjustments: the gender is right for women's matches; match type and level can be corrected.
Connect tablets offers only the ways this device can use (a phone: Internet).
The manage console is no longer cut off at the top; Back leaves it.
A match the server has closed no longer keeps a sync error that Retry cannot clear, and is never reopened on its own: load the official version or remove the copy.
Restoring a backup of a closed match is refused before anything changes.
Phone: the scoring header lists home – away.
The online switch shows a Wi-Fi icon.

Easy match: New match → Easy match is an unofficial match with no rosters, officials or signatures. Shirt numbers are typed with the line-ups (two libero boxes there) and a new substitute by its number; everything else is the normal scoreboard.

Theme: Options → Display mode → Theme chooses Light, Dark or E-ink. E-ink is black and white at full contrast, for reading the screen in bright sunlight. The bench, livescore and referee views have it in their menu.
Dark keeps team and shirt colours, flags and photos as they are.
In a narrow window the header's match chip no longer covers the tablet status; below 720 px the header uses its compact form.
A long connection status or translation no longer pushes the header off the screen: it switches to the compact form when the full one does not fit.
In a window 800 px wide the scoring screen fits: the point buttons no longer cover the set tables.
Bench view on the team tablets: back-row players as large as the front row, officials by role code (C, AC1, AC2, P, M), and the court usable with the tablet sideways.
The livescore shows the team names of a test match.
The action log shows local times instead of UTC.
Narrow windows and phones: Corrections, the rosters, the roster editor during a match and the scoresheet preview fit the width.
The "screen too small" notice is translated and offers the phone layout.
Closing the window asks whether OpenVolley keeps running in the tray or quits completely.
The "Update is ready" card no longer stays on "waits until OpenVolley has finished loading".
Narrow windows and phones: the header, the home screen, the backup list, the match setup, the coin toss and the scoreboard's rosters fit the width.
Clubs: an admin can tie each scorer to a club, so a scorer scores only the home games of that club. Off until an admin switches it on.
Scoresheet: approval, result and the rosters stand in their own boxes; every box ends on the same bottom line.
Scoresheet: the winner and the result share one line; league codes are compact ("1L D" becomes "1LD").
Scoresheet: every line of the sheet meets the lines above and below; set 5's third panel sits under set 4.
Scoresheet: saved on an iPhone, iPad or Mac, the PDF keeps the logo and the signatures.
Scoresheet: the PDF's title is the scoresheet's name; names in the approval box are left-aligned.
Signed in again, the "Session expired" notice goes as soon as the waiting changes are being sent.
A saved scoresheet is named game<n>_<league>_<date>.pdf.
The scoresheet stays at hand after the approval: preview, print or save it before closing the match.
Manager: a Scoresheets tab with every match and its stored scoresheet (PDF) to view or download, for admins and competition managers.
Manager: switch between OpenVolley and OpenBeach without signing in again.
Security update of the Android app runtime (Capacitor 8.5.3).
Pages load faster: the PDF code only loads when a PDF is made.
Updated libraries and build tools.
Fixes a crash when a libero was declared unable or re-designated.
Set 5: change of courts at 8 after every point, undo and reload.
Swap A/B only corrects the coin toss; Switch sides moves the teams.
Phone layout for the scorer.
Team colours: own colour picker, readable text, outlined shirts.
Slow tablets: a double tap no longer scores twice.
Remarks sync to the server.
Many smaller fixes.
Updates now come from Flatpak; the app no longer downloads its own.
Build fixes.
Scoresheet: new logo, actual times, no T marks.
Sign on a phone via a QR code.
Officials approve the result with account and PIN.
Corrections: guided match changes.
Activity log and undo history, synced.
Connect tablets in 3 steps.
Every action updates all screens at once.
Fixes: substitution limit, time-outs, set 5.
Rosters show positions and sanctions.
Line-up with optional game captain; grouped menu.
New date/time pickers; open or share the saved PDF.
New logo and app icon.
Accounts are created on manager.openvolley.app; password reset by email.
Referee view: player circles and badges fit every tablet.
Dialogs no longer close when selecting text; date of birth typed as DD.MM.YYYY.
Many missing German, Swiss German and French texts added.
